title: Sleep Lab
tagline: Do I snore? Fitbit Air SpO2 meets overnight audio.
summary: I've been told I snore but never heard it. This records the room overnight, finds snores with a pretrained audio model (YAMNet), and lines them up with my Fitbit Air's SpO2 to see if my oxygen drops afterwards. Works on fake data so far, real nights next.
highlights: Fitbit's API got replaced by the Google Health API four days before I started, so it uses the new one
Audio is processed a minute at a time and thrown away, only snore timestamps and a few short clips are kept
SpO2 dips after snoring are compared against random times in the night, since wrist SpO2 is noisy
Next up: real nights, then Garmin run data and an MCP server
